summary: Neighbors sue after a council backs the staff's approval of an apartment complex on a steep site.
realLife: A council voted six to three to uphold planners' approval of an apartment complex for homeless young adults. Neighbors argued the height and density broke the area plan and that a hazard report on a steep slope was thin. A motion to send the report to a state survey failed. Supporters said they trusted staff and wanted no more delay. A resident and two groups then sued to overturn it, and the city would not comment.
